login.title: Sign in to Bilibili
login.hint: Scan with the Bilibili app; it finishes here once you confirm on the phone.
login.expired: The code expired. Open the sign-in window again.
error.notPlayable: This video has no usable audio track
error.noBackend: No bilibili backend is configured (VITE_BILIBILI_API_BASE); the web build cannot use this source.
filter.sectionNote: Bilibili is a video platform, and most folders are not song lists. This decides which folders appear under Playlists.
filter.pageNote: Check the folders you want as playlists. Unchecked ones never appear under Playlists, and their covers are not fetched.
filter.failed: Could not read the folders. Try again later.
filter.title: Which folders should show?
filter.note: Bilibili is a video platform and most folders are not song lists. Check the ones you want to listen to; you can also keep showing everything.
